title: Spatially selective ultrasound field formation using acoustic holography for cultured-cell applications

summary_en: Presents an acoustic-holography framework that combines the Iterative Angular Spectrum Approach with Adam-based phase and amplitude optimization for a 4 x 4 ultrasound phased array. Hydrophone measurements and standing-wave reconstruction show localized acoustic-intensity formation in a cell-culture-compatible geometry, with all measured non-target regions below the specified exposure criterion.
publication_note: Available online on 2026-07-10; the official record lists Journal of Biomechanics volume 205, article 113466.

summary_en: Introduces SCFusion, a forward-looking-sonar and optical-camera fusion network for underwater object detection. The method uses vision-guided context aggregation and camera-sonar complementary reasoning to combine visual semantics with sonar geometry, and is evaluated on the multimodal UMOD dataset.
publication_note: The official record assigns the paper to Ocean Engineering volume 363, Part 4, dated 2026-08-15; the exact online-first date was not independently resolved.
